_doc: The duel «a tres tiempos» (docs/gdd/04e_combate.md; draft for the owner, Gate O-C*): the shared combat resolution of the duel and, later, of the rogue (4.22.6.1). Pure rules in sim/combat/ (CombatRules, Duel); nothing in the game calls them yet. Every lance both fighters choose one action: strike beats feint, feint beats parry, parry beats strike. The winner of the exchange tries a touch (touch: SkillCheck martial vs martial + advantage); a tie on strike is a clash (clash: whoever wins it touches); a tie on a weapon's edge action is a one-sided roll for its holder when its weapons.<w>.tie > 0 (weapons.<w>.touch: extra on the touch of its edge action). Lances 1..blind are blind (nobody shows a gesture); after them the initiative alternates, the challenger first: the leader chooses first and shows a gesture; the reader sees a cue that tells the truth with read_chance = base + (reader.empathy - leader.martial) x step, clamped to [min, max] (a lie shows one of the two other actions). breath: max = base + floor(constitution x per_constitution) + weapon breath; each action costs actions.<a>.breath (negative = recovers), an action that costs more than the breath left is not allowed (parry is always allowed). kinds: touches to win, lances at most (then more touches wins, equal = draw), whether the loser is wounded and whether one may yield; to_death is locked (O4). ai: the policy of the rival and of «Resolver sin jugar» (reads the cue and answers it; when leading, counters the opponent's most frequent action with probability habit once there are min_history lances, else a mix with edge_weight extra for the weapon's edge; yields in a duel that allows it when the opponent needs one touch and it is behind by yield_behind, with yield_chance). items: which equipped item fights as which weapon (anything else: fists); armor_items: the clothes that count as armour (armor.against on the rolls against its wearer). Every roll is keyed (world seed | combat | duel | lance | what): it never moves another roll of the game. [balance]

challenge._doc: Duels in the game (docs/gdd/04e_combate.md §4e.3-§4e.5, sim/combat/duels.gd) [balance]. causes: offense (the actor or an adult of their family holds one of offense_states towards the target's family: an insult or threat of H7), courtship (both court the same single adult with affinity >= courtship_min_affinity: «about» is the one with the highest of the two), rivalry (the families own a building of the same type: the trade's rival). min_age, cooldown_days (the same pair, after a closed duel), kinds_allowed (O-C11: first blood for now). The challenged answers before the next dawn (answer_hour); the duel is at hour (minute of the day) of the day after accepting, at the map spawn named in ground (the first that exists); call_before minutes before it both are sent there. present_tiles: how near the ground counts as being there; witness_tiles: who sees it (and who saw the challenge, near the challenger); public_witnesses: from how many it is public (consequences.public_mult). fight_timeout: game minutes a played duel may stay open (then the AI plays the rest). The NPC answer (ai_answer): accept when its chance of winning (samples automatic duels) >= accept_min + (risk_aversion - 0.5) x risk_step, or when it is short of that by less than near_miss and refusing would cost it reputation; refuses for free with title_gap_free or more title steps above the challenger (O-C8).

consequences._doc: What a duel leaves (04e §4e.5) [balance]. Reputation is the honour (Reputation.change, reason duel_<outcome>); a public duel (>= public_witnesses) doubles it; a gain is weighted by the rival's title: 1 + title_weight_step per step of the rival above you, at most title_weight_max. relation: the permanent relation between the two. refuse: the refuser loses reputation only if somebody saw the challenge; the challenger gains challenger. no_show: who did not come. courtship (cause courtship, with «about»): affinity of each duellist with the courted one. brawl (fighting outside the rules, order duel_brawl): a public fact with charge for the attacker's family when somebody saw it, reputation and relation.
